pricing_and_gst.tax_application_rule: Base prices for all packages, ceremony upgrades, and optional logistics are presented as numerical integers and listed exclusive of tax. A prevailing Goods and Services Tax (GST) of 9% is dynamically calculated and added to the subtotal in the final quote breakdown. Government and third-party municipal disbursements, such as Mandai Crematorium fees (S$315) or Choa Chu Kang Cemetery permit fees, are not subject to GST markup and are billed at cost.
pricing_and_gst.itemised_disclosures: All service options, additions, caskets, hearses, and logistics are fully itemized in quotes and invoices. On-site add-ons during the wake must be confirmed via a signed addendum, and no verbal agreements or undocumented surcharges are permitted under any circumstances.

cancellation_and_refunds.deposit_refund_rules: Clients are entitled to a full refund of their initial booking deposit if cancellation occurs within the 24-hour cooling-off period, provided that no operational dispatch has commenced (such as body collection or embalming) and no municipal wake permits have been registered.

cancellation_fees_by_stage.fee_structure: If cancellation occurs within the cooling-off period but administrative work (e.g., certificate translation, booking queue setup) has started, a flat administrative fee of S$150 is deducted from the refund.
Once the transport team has been dispatched for body collection from home or hospital, a fee of S$350 is charged to cover transport costs.
If embalming, dressing, and cosmetological styling have been completed, a fee of S$800 is charged to cover professional labor and sanitization consumables.
If the wake tentage (HDB void deck) or parlour layout has already been set up and utility meters connected, 50% of the total base package price is billed to cover third-party logistics and labor.
Cancellations on the final day of the procession are non-refundable, and 100% of the selected package, upgrades, and ceremonies are billed in full.

quotations.itemisation_rules: All official quotations generated by Solace Dignity Care are valid for 14 calendar days from the date of issue. The quotation must specify the base package price, selected religious rites, caskets, wake durations, and distinct third-party disbursements.
quotations.interim_billing_policy: Variable daily costs (such as guest catering buffers, packet beverage consumption, and physical flower wreaths) are tracked on an interim daily audit sheet. This sheet is reviewed and signed off by the on-site Funeral Butler and next-of-kin every 24 hours. The final bill is audited against these signed sheets, preventing unexpected billing surprises.

service_provider_governance.impartiality_guarantee: Solace Dignity Care operates on a strict zero-commission model. We do not accept kickbacks, rebates, or referral fees from third-party partners (such as catering companies, paper effigy builders, or florists). All recommended partners must pass savings directly to families, guaranteeing unbiased recommendations based purely on quality and cost-effectiveness.
service_provider_governance.performance_guarantees: We guarantee that the assigned Funeral Director or setup team will arrive at the wake location at least 30 minutes before the scheduled wake commencement. If setup is delayed by more than 60 minutes due to coordinator negligence, a service credit of S$250 is applied to the final invoice.
service_provider_governance.dispute_resolution: In the event of an operational dispute, families can contact the Operations Manager via the 24/7 hotline. A senior manager will conduct an on-site review within 2 hours. A formal resolution proposal will be provided in writing within 24 hours of report submission.

data_privacy.pdpa_compliance: In compliance with the Singapore Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA), all sensitive digital files (including NRIC scans, Death Certificates, and CCOD records) are encrypted in transit and at rest. These documents are accessed strictly by the assigned Funeral Director for official permit applications (NEA, SLA, LTA, Town Council).
